mapper.insert: insert into biz_medical_query_batch ( batch_no, company_id, service_mode, query_type, batch_status, total_count, pending_count, processing_count, completed_count, hit_count, no_result_count, failed_count, cancelled_count, total_fee, request_ip, create_time, complete_time, update_time ) values ( #{batchNo}, #{companyId}, #{serviceMode}, #{queryType}, #{batchStatus}, #{totalCount}, #{pendingCount}, #{processingCount}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{totalFee}, #{requestIp}, sysdate(), null, sysdate() )
mapper.sql: select aggregate.*, case when aggregate.cancelled_count = aggregate.total_count then 'CANCELLED' when aggregate.completed_count + aggregate.failed_count + aggregate.cancelled_count = aggregate.total_count and aggregate.failed_count > 0 and aggregate.completed_count > 0 then 'PARTIAL_FAILED' when aggregate.completed_count + aggregate.failed_count + aggregate.cancelled_count = aggregate.total_count and aggregate.failed_count > 0 then 'FAILED' when aggregate.completed_count + aggregate.failed_count + aggregate.cancelled_count = aggregate.total_count and aggregate.cancelled_count > 0 then 'PARTIAL_CANCELLED' when aggregate.completed_count + aggregate.failed_count = aggregate.total_count then 'COMPLETED' when aggregate.processing_count > 0 or aggregate.completed_count > 0 or aggregate.failed_count > 0 then 'PROCESSING' else 'PENDING' end as batch_status from ( select b.id, b.batch_no, b.company_id, c.company_name, b.service_mode, b.query_type, count(i.id) as total_count, coalesce(sum(i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' and r.process_status = 'PENDING'), 0) as pending_count, coalesce(sum(i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' and r.process_status = 'PROCESSING'), 0) as processing_count, coalesce(sum(i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' and r.process_status = 'COMPLETED'), 0) as completed_count, coalesce(sum(i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' and r.result_status = 'HIT'), 0) as hit_count, coalesce(sum(i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' and r.result_status in ('NO_RESULT', 'HINT_ONLY')), 0) as no_result_count, coalesce(sum(i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' and r.process_status = 'FAILED'), 0) as failed_count, coalesce(sum(i.item_status = 'CANCELLED' or r.process_status = 'CANCELLED'), 0) as cancelled_count, coalesce(sum(case when i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' and i.reused_flag = '0' then r.fee_snapshot else 0 end), 0.00) as total_fee, b.create_time, b.complete_time, b.update_time from biz_medical_query_batch b left join biz_insurance_company c on c.id = b.company_id left join biz_medical_query_batch_item i on i.batch_id = b.id left join biz_medical_query_request r on r.id = i.request_id where b.service_mode = 'DELAYED' group by b.id, b.batch_no, b.company_id, c.company_name, b.service_mode, b.query_type, b.create_time, b.complete_time, b.update_time ) aggregate
mapper.select: select i.id, i.batch_id, i.request_id, r.request_no, i.row_no, i.reused_flag, i.item_status, r.patient_name, r.id_card, case when i.item_status = 'CANCELLED' then 'CANCELLED' else r.process_status end as process_status, r.upload_status, case when i.item_status = 'CANCELLED' then 'CANCELLED' else r.result_status end as result_status, case when i.item_status = 'ACTIVE' then r.fee_snapshot else 0.00 end as fee_snapshot, i.create_time, i.update_time from biz_medical_query_batch_item i inner join biz_medical_query_request r on r.id = i.request_id where i.batch_id = #{batchId} order by i.row_no, i.id

select i.id as item_id, i.batch_id, b.batch_no, i.request_id, i.reused_flag, i.item_status, r.request_no, r.entry_type, r.process_status, r.upload_status, r.reserved_fee, r.billing_month from biz_medical_query_batch_item i inner join biz_medical_query_batch b on b.id = i.batch_id inner join biz_medical_query_request r on r.id = i.request_id where i.batch_id = #{batchId} order by i.row_no for update

select i.id as item_id, i.batch_id, b.batch_no, i.request_id, i.reused_flag, i.item_status, r.request_no, r.entry_type, r.process_status, r.upload_status, r.reserved_fee, r.billing_month from biz_medical_query_batch_item i inner join biz_medical_query_batch b on b.id = i.batch_id inner join biz_medical_query_request r on r.id = i.request_id where b.company_id = #{companyId} and i.id = #{itemId} for update
mapper.update: update biz_medical_query_batch_item set item_status = 'CANCELLED', update_time = sysdate() where id = #{itemId} and item_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_medical_query_batch_item where request_id = #{requestId} and item_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update biz_medical_query_request set process_status = 'CANCELLED', result_status = 'CANCELLED', fee_snapshot = 0.00, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{requestId} and service_mode = 'DELAYED' and process_status = 'PENDING' and upload_status = 'NOT_UPLOADED'

join biz_medical_query_batch_item i on i.batch_id = b.id left join biz_medical_query_request r on r.id = i.request_id where b.company_id = #{companyId} and b.service_mode = 'DELAYED' group by b.id, b.batch_no, b.service_mode, b.create_time ) summary order by summary.create_time desc, summary.batch_id desc limit 100
mapper.update: update biz_medical_query_batch set batch_status = #{batchStatus}, total_count = #{totalCount}, pending_count = #{pendingCount}, processing_count = #{processingCount}, completed_count = #{completedCount}, hit_count = #{hitCount}, no_result_count = #{noResultCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, cancelled_count = #{cancelledCount}, total_fee = #{totalFee}, complete_time = case when #{batchStatus} in ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_FAILED') then coalesce(complete_time, sysdate()) else null end, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{batchId}
